Brand Introduction:

GutterBrush is a trusted and proven gutter protection solution that has been serving homeowners for over 20 years. Based in the U.S., GutterBrush is known for its simple yet highly effective gutter guard system that prevents clogs caused by leaves, pine needles, and other debris. The brand is built on a foundation of reliability, ease of installation, and long-term performance, offering homeowners a cost-effective way to protect their gutters and avoid expensive damage.

Product Description:

GutterBrush consists of a durable, cylindrical brush that fits easily inside standard gutters. Made from UV-resistant polypropylene bristles wrapped around a galvanized steel core, the brush allows water to flow through while keeping debris out. It's suitable for gutters of all types and sizes, ranging from 4" to 7", and is designed to be installed quickly without tools or professional assistance. Customers love its low-maintenance design, which helps keep gutters clear year-round with minimal effort.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

The unique selling point of GutterBrush is its unmatched simplicity and effectiveness. It offers one of the easiest DIY installations on the market, with no tools required. Unlike many complicated or expensive gutter guard systems, GutterBrush provides long-lasting clog protection with a straightforward, reliable design that can be installed by anyone in just minutes. Its low-maintenance nature and adaptability to various gutter types make it a versatile, hassle-free solution for homeowners.

Payment Terms:

As part of the affiliate or referral program, GutterBrush offers competitive commission rates for each sale made through the affiliate’s link or referral. Affiliates can expect timely payments on a set schedule (monthly or bi-weekly, depending on the agreement) once the referred sale is confirmed. Specific commission percentages and thresholds will be discussed and outlined during the partnership agreement.

Other Information:

  • Marketing Support: GutterBrush provides affiliates with a variety of marketing materials, including banners, product images, and content support, to help drive conversions.
  • Strong Brand Reputation: With decades of experience and hundreds of positive customer testimonials, GutterBrush is a product affiliates can confidently promote.
  • Wide Audience Appeal: GutterBrush appeals to homeowners, DIY enthusiasts, and professionals alike, making it a versatile product with broad market potential.
  • Proven Results: The product has been rigorously tested and proven effective in various climates, providing reliable gutter protection in rain, snow, and heat.

GutterBrush is committed to creating a win-win relationship with affiliates by offering an attractive product and generous support for success.

GutterBrush® Affiliate Paid Advertising (PPC) Policy

Effective Date: 12/12/2025
Applies To: All affiliates participating in the GutterBrush Affiliate Program

GutterBrush is a family-owned, Made-in-USA brand. To protect our brand integrity, customer experience, and paid advertising investments, the following Paid Search (PPC) policy applies to all affiliates.

1. General Policy Overview

Affiliates may not use paid advertising in a manner that:

  • Competes directly with GutterBrush’s own paid advertising campaigns

  • Inflates branded keyword costs

  • Misleads customers or misrepresents GutterBrush products

  • Intercepts traffic that would otherwise go directly to GutterBrush

Affiliates are responsible for ensuring compliance with this policy at all times.

2. Prohibited Paid Search Activities (Strictly Not Allowed)

🚫 2.1 Brand Keyword Bidding

Affiliates may NOT bid on, target, or appear for any of the following:

  • Brand names

    • GutterBrush

    • Gutter Brush

    • GutterBrush.com

  • Misspellings or variations

    • Gutter Brsh

    • GutterBrsh

    • GutterBrush gutter guards

  • Brand + modifier terms

    • Buy GutterBrush

    • GutterBrush reviews

    • GutterBrush coupon

    • GutterBrush discount

  • Competitor conquest terms that include our brand

    • “GutterBrush vs ___”

This restriction applies to:

  • Google Ads

  • Microsoft/Bing Ads

  • Any other paid search platform

🚫 2.2 Use of Brand Name in Ad Copy or Display URL

Affiliates may NOT:

  • Use “GutterBrush” or variations in:

    • Ad headlines

    • Ad descriptions

    • Display URLs

  • Imply they are GutterBrush or an official representative

🚫 2.3 Direct-to-Site Paid Traffic

Affiliates may NOT send paid search traffic directly to:

  • gutterbrush.com

  • Any GutterBrush landing page

  • Any page owned or controlled by GutterBrush

Affiliate paid ads must first direct traffic to:

  • The affiliate’s own website

  • A review, comparison, or educational page

  • Content that adds genuine value to the customer

🚫 2.4 Coupon, Deal, or Promotion Interception

Affiliates may NOT:

  • Run ads targeting:

    • “coupon,” “promo code,” “discount,” or similar terms

  • Promote private or exclusive discounts not authorized by GutterBrush

  • Run paid ads during major GutterBrush promotions unless explicitly approved

3. Permitted Paid Advertising Activities (Allowed with Conditions)

✅ 3.1 Non-Brand, Problem-Based Keywords

Affiliates may run paid search ads targeting non-branded, informational or problem-based keywords such as:

  • Large commercial gutter guard

  • Gutter protection for metal buildings

  • 8 inch gutter guard solution

  • Gutter overflow prevention

  • Warehouse gutter clogging

These campaigns must:

  • Avoid all brand terms

  • Provide informational or comparative content

  • Comply with all ad copy rules below

✅ 3.2 Educational & Review-Based Content

Affiliates may promote:

  • Product reviews

  • Comparisons

  • Educational articles

  • “Best solution for…” style content

As long as:

  • Claims are accurate

  • Content is not misleading

  • No prohibited keywords or brand misuse occurs

4. Ad Copy & Messaging Standards

Affiliates must ensure:

  • All claims are truthful and verifiable

  • No exaggerated or misleading promises (e.g., “never clean gutters again”)

  • No false urgency or deceptive language

  • No impersonation of GutterBrush

GutterBrush reserves the right to request ad copy for review at any time.

5. Monitoring & Enforcement

GutterBrush actively monitors:

  • Search engine results

  • Auction insights

  • Affiliate traffic sources

Violations may result in:

  • Immediate removal from the affiliate program

  • Forfeiture of unpaid commissions

  • Reversal of commissions tied to non-compliant traffic

  • Permanent ban from future participation

6. Right to Modify Policy

GutterBrush reserves the right to:

  • Update or modify this policy at any time

  • Temporarily restrict paid advertising during peak promotional periods

  • Make case-by-case exceptions in writing

Affiliates are responsible for staying current with policy updates.

7. Questions & Approval Requests

Affiliates unsure whether a campaign is compliant must request written approval before launching ads.
